普林斯顿中文剧社（PCT）成立于 2008 年，是由学生组织、创作和演出的中文剧: Founded in 2008, Princeton Chinese Theatre (PCT) is a student-run Chinese-language theatre group.
我们在普林斯顿演出中文戏剧，作品涵盖经典、当代与原创剧目。剧社成员共同参与表演、: We bring classic, contemporary and original Chinese-language plays to the Princeton stage. Our members work together on acting, sets, lighting, sound, costumes, translation and publicity, taking each production from rehearsal to performance.

普林斯顿大学中文剧社（Princeton Chinese Theatre）是全美: Princeton Chinese Theatre is the first Chinese-language university theatre group in the United States founded entirely by students. Through Chinese-language theatre, we promote Chinese culture and the dramatic arts within and beyond the university community. We present a new production each fall and spring.
不论背景，不论经验，欢迎对戏剧感兴趣的同学加入。: Students interested in theatre are welcome to join, regardless of background or experience.

普林斯顿中文剧社（PCT）创立于 2008 年，是全美大学第一个完全由学生创办的: Founded in 2008, Princeton Chinese Theater is the first Chinese-language theatre group at an American university founded entirely by students.
我们致力于通过表演中文话剧的形式，在校内外推广中国文化。我们曾经的导演队伍包含普: We promote Chinese culture on campus and beyond through Chinese-language theatre. Our directors have included Princeton students and Chinese-language instructors, while our casts have brought together Princeton students from different class years, countries and fields of study, as well as students from other institutions. Each spring and fall, PCT presents a new production, bringing together people within and beyond Princeton who share a love of the Chinese language and theatre.
两个剧组意外订下同一间排练场，不得不轮流排戏。《暗恋》讲述江滨柳与云之凡因战乱分: Two theatre companies discover they have booked the same rehearsal space. In Secret Love, Jiang Binliu and Yun Zhifan are separated by war and reunited decades later. In Peach Blossom Land, a fisherman fleeing his wife and her lover stumbles into a hidden paradise. As the companies compete for the stage, their contrasting stories of lost love and an unreachable home begin to echo one another.
一个闷热的夏日，周公馆里积压多年的矛盾逐渐爆发。周萍与女佣四凤相恋，继母繁漪不愿: On a stifling summer day, long-suppressed tensions surface in the Zhou household. Zhou Ping loves the maid Sifeng, while his stepmother Fanyi refuses to relinquish their secret relationship and his younger brother also falls for Sifeng. When Sifeng’s mother arrives, her buried history with the patriarch Zhou Puyuan exposes family ties that turn these entangled desires toward tragedy.
孤儿吴敬安被陈家收养，却在养兄弟突发哮喘时迟疑伸出援手。多年后，他成为医生，一通: Adopted into the Chen family, the orphan Wu Jing’an hesitates to help when his adoptive brother suffers an asthma attack. Years later, now a doctor, he receives a blackmail call that brings the past back into his life. Protecting everything he has gained means confronting the choice he once made and the conflict between ambition and conscience.
齐国大夫邹忌从家人对自己与美男子徐公的评价中察觉，亲近的人也可能因偏爱、畏惧或有: When Zou Ji asks how his looks compare with the handsome Xu Gong, the answers reveal how affection, fear and self-interest can conceal the truth. At the court of Qi, he turns this personal discovery into advice for the king, seeking a way through flattery and competing interests to make honest counsel heard.
公园里，老人、少女、兄弟与情侣各自等待着一个人、一段往事的答案，或一次改变生活的: In a park, an elderly man, a young woman, brothers and lovers each wait for someone, an answer from the past, or a chance for life to change. Their encounters gradually connect seemingly unrelated lives. Some remain caught in memory, some hide secrets, and others hold on to the hope that waiting will bring something new.
离婚后的白流苏回到上海娘家，在亲人的冷眼中寻找新的出路。她与富商范柳原相识，两人: After her divorce, Bai Liusu returns to an unwelcoming family home in Shanghai. She meets the wealthy Fan Liuyuan, and their courtship continues in Hong Kong. She seeks the security of marriage; he resists commitment. When war reaches the city, their careful bargaining gives way to a more immediate need for one another.
年轻工程师蒋飞来到一座北方县城，希望开启新的生活，现实却让他的理想屡屡受挫。当日: Young engineer Jiang Fei arrives in a northern county town hoping to begin a new life, only to find his ambitions repeatedly frustrated. As his days lose direction, a phone call and an unexpected encounter interrupt the familiar routine, forcing him to reconsider what he wants and whether connection with others is still possible.
八个互不相识的人在偏远车站等候一列迟迟不来的火车。漫长的等待中，他们争论、倾诉，: Eight strangers wait at a remote station for a train that never seems to arrive. As time passes, they argue, share their troubles and question whether the train will stop at all. Some insist on staying; others begin to doubt the wait itself. An ordinary delay becomes a decision about how each of them will live.
犀牛饲养员马路爱上邻居明明，认定她是自己生命中不可替代的人。明明却执着于另一个男: Rhino keeper Malu falls in love with his neighbour Mingming and becomes convinced that no one could ever replace her. But Mingming remains devoted to another man. Each attempt to win her affection ends in rejection. Despite his friends’ advice, Malu refuses to let go, and his longing gradually becomes an obsession he can no longer control.
一宗刑事案件审理结束后，十二名陪审员进入陪审室，决定被告是否有罪。原本看似明确的: After a criminal trial, twelve jurors enter a room to decide the defendant’s guilt. What appears to be a straightforward case begins to unravel when one juror raises a doubt. As arguments intensify, personal histories, prejudices and emotions shape the debate. The jurors must reconsider the evidence and the responsibility of passing judgment.
一位台湾女主管与一位大陆男主管在香港会面，商谈两家公司的合并。谈判刚开始，两人的: A Taiwanese executive meets a mainland Chinese executive in Hong Kong to negotiate a company merger. Each is accompanied by an alter ego who voices thoughts and desires the outward self would rather conceal. As business and private feelings become entangled, the two begin to wonder whether they have met before—and whether they once shared a love they have forgotten.
三十年代的上海，出身贫寒的阮玲玉走进电影世界，成为备受瞩目的女演员。银幕上的成功: In 1930s Shanghai, Ruan Lingyu rises from poverty to become a celebrated film actress. Success on screen offers little protection from the demands of those close to her, troubled relationships and newspaper gossip. As her private life becomes a public spectacle, her struggle to preserve her dignity grows increasingly desperate.
李响住进精神病院，自称是诗人李白，又时而坚持自己根本没有病。他与一心成名的“白兰: Li Xiang enters a psychiatric hospital claiming to be the poet Li Bai, while also insisting that he is not ill. He forms unlikely friendships with patients consumed by dreams of fame and power. As a nurse tries to help him, the painful history behind his retreat comes to light, and he must decide whether he can face the world again.
一个不相信爱情的现代青年意外穿越到战火纷飞的民国，与一群爱国、进步的青年相识。他: A young man who no longer believes in love is unexpectedly transported to wartime Republican China. Among a group of idealistic young people, he witnesses his grandmother’s first love and finds a romance of his own. As private feelings collide with the upheavals of the time, he begins to understand what commitment and sacrifice can mean.
一所偏远乡村学校为了多领一份经费，把负责拉水的驴虚报成老师“吕得水”。上级突然前: To secure extra funding, a remote village school lists its water-carrying donkey as a teacher named Lü Deshui. When an official announces an inspection, the staff recruit a coppersmith to impersonate their fictional colleague. A lie meant to protect the school demands ever more lies, exposing how power and self-interest can destroy the community they hoped to save.
玩世不恭的高辕与自然博物馆解说员小优相遇，起初以为自己掌握着这段关系，却不知道小: Cynical Gao Yuan meets Xiaoyou, a museum guide, and assumes he is in control of their attraction. He does not know that she carries a secret connected to the heart beating in his chest. One refuses to believe in love; the other insists on finding a miracle in a fragile life. Their hidden motives draw them into an increasingly painful attachment.
十名陌生人应邀来到一座孤岛，却始终不见邀请他们的主人。晚餐时，一段录音指控每个人: Ten strangers arrive on an isolated island at the invitation of a host who never appears. A recording accuses each guest of a crime that went unpunished. Then deaths begin to follow the pattern of a nursery rhyme. Cut off from help, the survivors turn on one another as they try to identify the killer before the next death.
多年未见的九名儿时同学重新聚在一起。摆地摊的赵自强、跑船后开出租车的李仁龙，以及: Nine childhood classmates reunite after years apart. Now working in very different jobs and carrying complicated private lives, they try to recover the closeness of the days when they played house together. Old attractions, rivalries and wounds resurface, revealing how far their adult lives have taken them from the children they remember.
1922年，北平郊外的冯医生收到一封来自上海的陌生电报，随后又迎来一连串不速之客: In 1922, Doctor Feng receives a mysterious telegram from Shanghai at his home outside Beiping. Unexpected visitors soon follow, all interested in works left by a deceased painter. Pictures once thought worthless become objects of intense competition. Over a single day, the promise of wealth disrupts the household and brings out competing loyalties and desires.
北京裕泰茶馆的掌柜王利发努力维持生意，盼着靠勤快与周全让日子安稳下去。茶客们来来: Wang Lifa, proprietor of Beijing’s Yutai Teahouse, hopes that hard work and careful diplomacy will keep his business alive. Customers bring news and troubles from three periods: the late Qing dynasty, the Republican era and the aftermath of the war against Japan. Across half a century, their changing fortunes reveal the struggle of ordinary people to survive upheaval.
未来的北京被分成三个相互隔离的空间，不同阶层的人过着截然不同的生活。第三空间的老: A future Beijing is divided into three separate spaces whose inhabitants live sharply different lives. Lao Dao, a resident of the third space, crosses those boundaries to deliver a message for a young man from the second. The journey exposes fractures in family, love and the city’s order, raising unsettling questions about feeling and human existence.
唐僧师徒历经艰险，终于取得真经，却并未就此结束旅程。重回东土之后，悟空的野心、唐: Obtaining the scriptures is not the end of the journey for Tang Sanzang and his disciples. Back in the East, Wukong’s ambition, his master’s faith, Bajie’s appetites and Sha’s acceptance of fate bring new difficulties. Having fulfilled a shared mission, the four must decide what comes next and find a direction beyond the quest that united them.
在物资匮乏的年代，青年王一生随着下乡的知青来到乡间。他珍惜每一口饭，也把全部热情: Sent to the countryside during the Cultural Revolution, Wang Yisheng values every mouthful of food while devoting himself to Chinese chess. Friends, wandering players and a succession of encounters sharpen his skill. In a world of material scarcity, the game becomes more than competition: it offers a way to sustain an inner life beyond the demands of survival.
赵昭雪被赶出故乡多年后，带着巨额财富回到日渐衰败的青石沟。她愿意帮助村庄摆脱困境: Years after being driven out, Zhao Zhaoxue returns wealthy to her declining home village, Qingshigou. She offers the villagers a way out of poverty, but demands a human life in return. Their initial moral outrage begins to weaken before the prospect of prosperity, while shopkeeper Gao Shouyi is forced to confront a past the village would rather forget.
四位移居美国的中国母亲与各自的女儿，在亲情与文化差异中不断误解彼此。母亲们不愿轻: Four Chinese immigrant mothers and their American-raised daughters struggle to understand one another. The mothers’ largely unspoken histories shape the daughters’ choices about marriage, family and identity. As both generations begin to share their stories, demanding expectations and painful silences acquire meanings neither side had fully understood.
一群痴迷养鸟的人聚在一起，把各自对往日生活的眷恋寄托在鸟笼之中。随着精神分析与戏: A group of bird enthusiasts gathers around cages that hold not only birds but attachments to a vanishing way of life. When psychoanalysis and theatrical therapy enter their world, those attachments become symptoms to be explained and corrected. The encounters grow increasingly absurd, blurring the distinction between healer and patient, and between sanity and obsession.
钢厂工人陈桂林下岗后，靠组建小乐队维持生活。妻子归来争夺女儿的抚养权，而女儿只想: Laid-off steelworker Chen Guilin makes a precarious living with a small band. When his estranged wife returns to seek custody of their daughter, the girl asks for a piano. Unable to buy or borrow one, and defeated even in an attempt to steal one, Chen gathers his former coworkers in an abandoned factory to build a piano themselves.
二十世纪初的上海，斧头帮横行，四位功夫高手决定与其抗衡。郭靖、黄蓉、张三丰与杨康: In early twentieth-century Shanghai, the Axe Gang dominates the city until four martial artists challenge its power. Guo Jing, Huang Rong, Zhang Sanfeng and Yang Kang enter a new arena of conflict. Meanwhile, the gang’s four leaders pursue rival ambitions, and Zhuque’s schemes make the struggle as much a contest of strategy as of strength.
美国商人丹尼尔来到中国，希望为家族的标牌公司争取一份合同。顾问彼得教他理解“关系: American businessman Daniel travels to China to win a contract for his family’s sign-making company. His consultant Peter explains the importance of connections, but mistranslations and shifting alliances complicate every negotiation. Vice Minister Xi Yan offers help, and their dealings become an affair. Daniel believes they understand each other, only to discover that language is not their deepest barrier.
二十世纪六十年代末，屡遭打击的青年天体物理学家叶文洁进入大兴安岭深处的红岸基地，: In the late 1960s, young astrophysicist Ye Wenjie enters the secret Red Coast base deep in the Greater Khingan Mountains after a series of devastating experiences. During its search for extraterrestrial life, she discovers that the sun can amplify radio signals. Disillusioned with humanity, she sends a message into space—a choice that changes her life and humanity’s future.
东北小城里，曾经叛逆的少年庄树成为刑警，着手调查一桩十三年前的旧案。线索却逐渐指: In a northeastern industrial town, once-rebellious Zhuang Shu has become a detective investigating a thirteen-year-old case. The evidence leads toward his childhood friend Li Fei and her father. As the two families’ memories unfold, layoffs, a Christmas Eve promise and a fire return to view, and Zhuang discovers that his own past is inseparable from the mystery.
两名劫匪闯进银行，将四名职员困在一间狭小的房间里。警笛在外响个不停，电话一次次打: Two robbers trap four bank employees in a cramped room. Sirens sound outside, phones keep ringing, and three million in cash remains tantalisingly close in the vault. As the standoff drags on, the relationship between captors and hostages shifts. Beneath their ordinary lives, each person’s pressures, desires and fears begin to surface.
抗战时期，女学生王佳芝与同伴策划刺杀为侵略者效力的易先生。她以富商太太的身份接近: During the war, student Wang Jiazhi joins a plot to assassinate Mr Yi, a collaborator. Posing as a wealthy married woman, she draws close to him in an operation that depends on intimacy and deception. As the boundary between performance and feeling blurs, she must choose between the mission, her own desires and the lives at stake.
齐国大夫邹忌原以为自己生活美满，武林新秀徐公的出现却让他重新审视自己。富商韩武带: Zou Ji believes his life in Qi is happy and secure until the arrival of the young Xu Gong makes him reconsider it. A wealthy merchant, Han Wu, seeks his help, prompting a contest of words and motives. Meanwhile, the young king favours flatterers and rejects honest advice. Zou Ji must navigate private doubts and court intrigue to make his counsel heard.
一次穿越将现代生活与二战前夕的世界连接起来。一群青年在时代动荡中相识，在爱情、友: A journey through time connects the present with a world on the cusp of World War II. Young people find love and friendship amid upheaval, and their loyalties to one another and to shared ideals demand difficult choices. Personal affection becomes inseparable from responsibility and sacrifice.
玩世不恭的高辕与博物馆解说员小优相遇。高辕以为是自己诱惑了小优，却不知道她平静的: Cynical Gao Yuan meets Xiaoyou, a museum guide. He believes he has seduced her, unaware of the intense feelings and secret beneath her calm exterior. Bound together by a heart, one believes in nothing while the other searches for a miracle in a fragile life. Concealment and mutual hurt draw them deeper into love.
1922年，北平郊外的冯医生收到一封来自上海的陌生电报，随后又迎来一连串不速之客: In 1922, Doctor Feng receives a mysterious telegram from Shanghai at his home outside Beiping. A succession of unexpected visitors follows, disrupting the quiet household. Over a single day, nine sharply different personalities clash in a farce of money and competing interests.
唐僧、悟空、八戒与沙僧历经重重艰险，终于取得真经。但取经成功并不是故事的终点，师: Tang Sanzang, Wukong, Bajie and Sha overcome the trials of their pilgrimage and obtain the scriptures. But completing the quest is not the end of their story. The four travellers face further difficulties and choices in a journey that begins where the familiar tale leaves off.
物资匮乏的年代，被派往农村的知青们在艰难生活中寻找精神寄托。王一生珍惜食物，也痴: In a time of scarcity, young people sent to the countryside seek something beyond material survival. Wang Yisheng treasures food and is devoted to Chinese chess. Between the need to eat and the fulfilment of the game, he and those around him search for what sustains an inner life.
精神病院里，自称“李白”的李响与白兰度、某某、领导等病友相处。原本美好的生活被权: In a psychiatric hospital, Li Xiang—known as “Li Bai”—shares his days with Brando, Someone and the Leader. After power destroys the life he knew, he struggles with its painful aftermath while a nurse helps him through it. As the patients’ stories unfold, Li Xiang and Aunt Huifang each confront the past and seek release through forgiveness.
六名陌生人来到一座孤岛上的宅邸，一段神秘录音打破了聚会的平静。随着客人接连遭到杀: Six strangers gather in a mansion on an isolated island. A mysterious recording shatters the gathering, and murders begin to expose the secrets each guest has tried to hide. Unable to leave, the survivors turn on one another and race to identify the killer among them before another life is lost.
九个儿时的玩伴在十五年后重逢，来到海边进行一日一夜的聚会。他们骑马、嬉水、厮闹，: Nine childhood friends reunite fifteen years later for a day and a night by the sea. They play, splash in the water and try to recover their childhood through a game of playing house. But buried memories and wounds have not disappeared. Their apparent celebration turns toward revenge, and the reunion moves toward tragedy.
